name: Heatless Curling Set
tagline: Wrap damp hair at night. Shake out soft waves in the morning.
summary: A soft, cloth-covered foam rod you sleep in, with two scrunchie hair ties and a hair clip. No curling iron, no heat.
imageAlt: Pink heatless curling rod looped into a ribbon shape, with two scrunchie hair ties and a pink hair clip

gallery.alt: Close-up of the rod end, where the cloth cover is stitched closed

features: The curl sets as your hair dries overnight, so there's no hot iron and no heat-protect spray step.
A flexible foam rod with a soft cloth cover, plus two scrunchies to hold your hair in place.
Wrapping takes a few minutes once you've done it a couple of times. In the morning you unwrap and go.
steps: Lay the rod over the top of your head and secure the middle with the hair clip from the set.
Twist sections around the rod on each side, working down. Damp, not soaking, works best.
Secure each end with a scrunchie and go to bed.
Slide the rod out in the morning and loosen the waves with your fingers.

yes: Your hair reaches your shoulders or longer
You wrap it slightly damp and leave it in overnight
You want soft waves, not tight ringlets
no: Your hair is too short to wrap around a rod
You need it this week: delivery takes 11–18 days
You expect the same result on every hair type
fit.note: Results vary with hair length, thickness and texture.

specs: 1 curling rod, 2 scrunchie hair ties and 1 hair clip
Foam rod with a soft cloth cover, about 3 cm thick and 100 cm long (sizes may vary by 1–2 cm)
Pink, as shown (colour may look slightly different on your screen)
faq: Yes. The set comes with one hair clip to hold the rod in place, plus two scrunchie hair ties for the ends.
Will it work on short hair?
It works best on hair that reaches your shoulders or longer. Very short hair can't wrap around the rod.
